title: OpenAI is in preliminary talks to acquire the renowned security company Trail of Bits

content_html:
On October 13th local time, according to informed sources, the AI giant OpenAI is currently in early-stage negotiations to acquire the security startup Trail of Bits. This indicates that while OpenAI continues to advance its cutting-edge large model development, it is also increasing its investment in cybersecurity and foundational protection capabilities.

The talks between the two parties are still ongoing, and specific financial details and terms of the potential acquisition have not been disclosed publicly. As a renowned cybersecurity research and engineering consulting company in the industry, Trail of Bits has deep technical expertise in system security, cryptographic audits, and software vulnerability discovery.

Faced with the rapid evolution of advanced model capabilities and intelligent agents, risks such as jailbreak attacks, data leaks, and security compliance in AI systems are becoming increasingly evident. If this acquisition is finalized, it will help OpenAI further strengthen the underlying security defenses of its models, providing a more solid technological guarantee for its commercial deployment and enterprise-level services.
